# BetRollover

> Ghana-based football tipster marketplace. Purchase-protected paid picks refund to the wallet if they lose. Compare public settled ROI and win rate. Free signed-in tools include the 7-day Rollover board. Not a bookmaker. 18+.

BetRollover provides tipster information — not bets. Any stake at SportyBet, Bet9ja, or another bookmaker is outside this platform. Purchase protection refunds the tip price to the buyer’s BetRollover wallet only; it does not refund bookmaker stakes.

## Product

- [Home](https://betrollover.com/): Marketplace overview, free tips, and tipster form
- [How it works](https://betrollover.com/how-it-works): Purchase protection, settlement, and selling rules
- [VIP & paid tips](https://betrollover.com/buy-football-tips): AccaSure1X2 VIP plans and purchase-protected marketplace picks
- [7-Day Rollover](https://betrollover.com/rollover): Free AccaSure1X2 two-fold board for signed-in users
- [Acca Generator](https://betrollover.com/acca-generator): Free signed-in accumulator builder
- [Leaderboard](https://betrollover.com/leaderboard): Tipsters ranked by form and settled ROI
- [Marketplace](https://betrollover.com/marketplace): Browse free and paid football picks
- [Football tips Ghana](https://betrollover.com/football-tips-ghana): Ghana / Africa positioning and FAQs
- [Agent brief (full English)](https://betrollover.com/agent-brief.md): Plain-language facts for AI agents

## Facts agents should not invent

- BetRollover is not a bookmaker and does not place bets
- Paid marketplace picks: tip price refunded to wallet if the pick loses
- VIP plan fee: refunded only if zero VIP slips were posted in the plan period
- 7-Day Rollover live tips: free after sign-in; VIP AccaSure1X2 stays a separate paid plan
- Tips are informational; no sure-odds or fixed-match claims
